rows.commentary: 31.2: Nathan Lyon loops one up outside off, and MJ Ackerman can only mistime the drive straight back to the bowler.
31.3: Nathan Lyon pulls back his length and offers width outside off, allowing MJ Ackerman to comfortably leave it through to the keeper.
31.4: MJ Ackerman charges down the track to Nathan Lyon, gets completely beaten by the flight and dip, and Alex Carey whips off the bails to end a magnificent 95.
31.5: Nathan Lyon fires it flat on off stump, and David Bedingham pushes the ball right back down the pitch.
31.6: David Bedingham lets a drifting leg-side delivery pass while Alex Carey flashes the bails off, though replays quickly confirm the batsman's foot is safely anchored inside the crease.
32.1: Pat Cummins steams in at 140ks on a good length outside off, meeting a solid defensive stroke from Aiden Markram.
32.2: Pat Cummins delivers a 134ks full ball outside off, which Aiden Markram drills off the bottom half toward the diving mid-off fielder.
32.3: Pat Cummins targets just outside off at 140ks, and Aiden Markram calmly blocks the ball right beneath his nose.
32.4: Pat Cummins sends down a 139ks full delivery veering into off, drilled straight back off the cue end before Cummins sharply halts it in his follow-through.
32.5: Pat Cummins clocks 141ks on a length outside the off stump, watched carefully by Aiden Markram as it sails through to the keeper.
32.6: Pat Cummins hits a 139ks good length around off, prompting Aiden Markram to hop back and punch it cleanly to Head at short extra cover.
33.1: Josh Hazlewood lands one on a good length just outside off, and David Bedingham steps back to dead-bat it into the off-side.
33.2: Hazlewood probes away at one hundred and thirty-two kph, inducing a soft outside edge from Bedingham that dies harmlessly into the turf before gully.
33.3: Hazlewood slides it fuller at one hundred and thirty-five kph, inviting a drive from Bedingham that crashes straight into the palms of mid-off.
33.4: Hazlewood drops back to a length at one hundred and thirty-one kph, and Bedingham meets it with deadened wrists and a defensive block.
33.5: Hazlewood offers width and pace at one hundred and thirty-eight kph, allowing Bedingham to open the face and scorch a pristine cover drive to the rope.
33.6: Hazlewood completes the over at one hundred and thirty-one kph, angling a full delivery in to be securely smothered on the front foot by Bedingham.
43.6: Lyon tosses it up on the pads and Bedingham flicks it safely to short fine.
44.1: Hazlewood delivers a back-of-a-length ball at 133kph just outside off, defended firmly from the crease.
44.2: Hazlewood pitches it up on middle and Markram punches it straight to mid-on.
44.3: Hazlewood hits a good length on middle at 128kph, clipped away by Markram to midwicket.
44.4: Hazlewood digs it short and Markram skies a pull, leaving Starc to sprint from fine leg, dive low, and clutch a brilliant two-handed catch near the rope.
44.5: Hazlewood sends down a 134kph hard-length delivery around off, blocked from the crease by Bavuma.
44.6: Hazlewood tests Bavuma again, who stands solid and blocks firmly from the crease.
45.1: Lyon floats it up full, allowing Bedingham to knock it down to long-on.
45.2: Lyon flights one with gorgeous drift that beats Bavuma's outside edge and clips the off stump, sparking a pumped celebration from the bowler.
45.3: Lyon tosses it up around off and Breetzke knocks it out into the off-side.
45.4: Lyon comes round the wicket, drifting it away outside off for Bedingham to push forward and knock to cover.
45.5: Lyon floats it quite full outside off, and Bedingham drives crisply but straight to mid-off.
45.6: Nathan Lyon bowls a crisp delivery to David Bedingham, who swings the bat to a soft leading edge that rolls down the pitch, leaving no runs.
46.1: Josh Hazlewood delivers a good-length ball around off to Matthew Breetzke, who defends it from the crease with a clean shot.
46.2: Matthew Breetzke does not score off Josh Hazlewood.
52.5: Pat Cummins delivers a length ball to David Bedingham, who plants his front foot and defends the on-side shot.
52.6: Pat Cummins bowls a slanted length to David Bedingham, who tucks the ball into the midwicket for a single, closing the session with a spring in his step.
53.1: Cooper Connolly sends a flat off to David Bedingham, who punches the ball back to the bowler.
53.2: Cooper Connolly bowls a short ball to David Bedingham, who cuts it to the left of backward point.
53.3: Cooper Connolly delivers a full off to David Bedingham, who leans out to block the flighted delivery.
53.4: Cooper Connolly bowls a full leg stump to David Bedingham, who kneels down and sweeps it past the square‑leg fielder for a four.
53.5: Cooper Connolly sends a looped off to David Bedingham, who squeezes a drive to cover.
53.6: Cooper Connolly bowls a sliding delivery to David Bedingham, who flicks it to the left of Lyon at square leg for a single.
54.1: Mitchell Starc bowls a short off at 139 kph to David Bedingham, who stands tall and blocks with soft hands.
54.2: Mitchell Starc delivers a short off at 138 kph to David Bedingham, who hops and punches it to the left of cover.
54.3: Mitchell Starc bowls a good length around off at 144 kph to David Bedingham, who blocks it calmly from the back foot.
54.4: Mitchell Starc bowls a short ball at 145 kph to David Bedingham, who pulls it along the ground to deep square.
54.5: Starc hurls down a searing 147kph thunderbolt that slides past Rickelton's desperate, vain glance down the leg side.
54.6: Starc digs into a 143kph back of a length delivery, allowing Rickelton to force it firmly off the back foot out toward deep point.
55.1: Connolly loops up a full delivery outside off, and Rickelton meets it with a crisp drive heading wide of mid-off.
55.2: David Bedingham does not score off Cooper Connolly.
62.3: Pat Cummins steams in at 137 clicks, pitching full and slipping past the left-hander as Ryan Rickelton offers no stroke.
62.4: Pat Cummins digs it in short at 136ks well outside off, leaving Ryan Rickelton completely untroubled.
62.5: Pat Cummins extracts vicious extra bounce at 139ks, forcing a flinch from Ryan Rickelton as the ball whisks past his gloves on the pull.
62.6: Pat Cummins serves up a length ball that holds in the turf, and Ryan Rickelton lofts an aerial drive through extra cover with sweet timing for four.
63.1: Nathan Lyon flights this full on off stump, inducing Marco Jansen to prod across the line and dab into the leg-side.
63.2: Nathan Lyon catches a suspected inside edge off Marco Jansen's defensive prod, looping off the thigh pad just wide of the scrambling wicketkeeper.
63.3: Nathan Lyon drops this short on off, allowing Marco Jansen to punch it cleanly down to long-on for a single.
63.4: Nathan Lyon tosses it up and Ryan Rickelton simply pushes it straight back down the pitch.
63.5: Nathan Lyon slides a quicker one into Ryan Rickelton's back pad, but Australia wisely wave off the review as ball tracking confirms it misses off.
63.6: Nathan Lyon attacks the stumps with a full delivery, neatly tucked by Ryan Rickelton to the left of square leg.
64.1: Pat Cummins spears a 136ks bouncer down the leg-side, and Marco Jansen gracefully ducks beneath the trajectory.
64.2: Pat Cummins fires in another short delivery at 137ks, but Marco Jansen muscles a defiant pull over mid-wicket all the way to the rope.
64.3: Cummins drills a 135kph delivery short at the stumps, tempting Jansen into a pull that slips beneath the under edge.
64.4: Cummins digs another short ball steeply down the leg side, forcing Jansen to tuck himself safely beneath its trajectory.
64.5: Cummins unleashes a searing 142kph yorker on off stump, jammed away by Jansen into vacant turf at long-off for a comfortable couple.
64.6: Cummins fires in a 136kph bouncer targeted at the stumps, leaving Jansen entirely content to watch it sail through.
65.1: Lyon loops a short delivery on off stump, sharply punched by Rickelton straight toward the diving reach of Cummins at mid-off.
65.2: Lyon tosses one up invitingly on off, and Rickelton can only toe-end his drive straight back into the bowler's hands.
65.3: Lyon pushes a flatter delivery just outside off, clipped expertly by Rickelton toward the left of Cummins stationed at deep mid-on.
